$comment: The WebGL methods of Khronos's IDL (contracts/runtime/webgl-idl/) that the facade does not define yet, grouped by why.
scripts/test-webgl-spec-surface-contract.sh fails when an IDL method is neither defined nor listed here, and when a listed one is defined.

unimplemented_methods.reason: Reads back state the render thread owns. Needs a synchronous answer path (as getProgramParameter has) or a JS-side shadow of the state; neither exists for these yet.
3D/array compressed texture entry points and the GPU-side wait. Each needs a render-stream record and a handler on the render thread.
Rarely used state calls: detaching a shader, validating a program, the sample-coverage mask. Cheap to add once the record shape for a no-reply call is copied.
`drawingBufferStorage` is a recent addition to the WebGL 2 interface that browsers do not ship; recorded so the list is the whole difference from the IDL, not a judgement that it will be written.
